decisions.decision: Offline pairwise analysis isolates the IoU failure to WebKit's eight curved-edge mask pixels at light 16px/DPR1; Chromium and Firefox masks match exactly. Keep the 1.15 mask cutoff and 0.90 IoU acceptance unchanged.
decisions.rationale: The same pairwise scores occur on all light backgrounds, and larger sizes pass; threshold sensitivity confirms the mismatches are edge coverage around the cutoff. A pinned-art revision requires brandbook authority.
